# TASK-653: Retire the always-on scanner and preserve the legacy store

## Metadata

- Kind: `implementation`

## Goal

Stop continuous scanning, staging, publication and pressure retention; rename the legacy store unmodified, open it read-only for export, migrate settings, and offer a confirmed delete.

## Deliverables

- Scanner retirement
- Legacy store migration, export and confirmed delete
- Rollback rehearsal

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-TASK-653-01` — After upgrade the app performs no traversal at idle: only capacity sampling and the change journal run; scan staging, publication and pressure retention code paths are removed or unreachable.
- `AC-TASK-653-02` — First launch renames evidence.sqlite to legacy/evidence-<date>.sqlite byte-for-byte, opens it read-only and only for export; watched roots become review scopes and the percentage threshold becomes a reserve suggestion; Delete legacy evidence requires confirmation; a rehearsed rollback restores the previous version by renaming back with evidence intact.

## Required Evidence

- `EVREQ-TASK-653-01` (migration-evidence) — Migration of a captured real-store copy with byte-identity check, export from the legacy store, and rollback rehearsal.
- `EVREQ-TASK-653-02` (regression-evidence) — Lifecycle tests proving no traversal or retention runs at idle.
